person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: whether losing GABA release from parvalbumin interneurons in the ventral subiculum is by itself enough to produce temporal lobe epilepsy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: whether a correlation seen in patients and models - selective loss of these cells - is causal, and whether the effect needs the silencing to be permanent
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: permanent silencing produces spontaneous recurrent seizures with no neurodegeneration, while transient silencing of the same cells produces nothing unless an excitatory challenge is added
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanism
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: sustained loss of perisomatic feedforward inhibition from parvalbumin basket cells lowers the seizure threshold of subicular pyramidal cells, which then generates spike-wave clusters and spontaneous seizures
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: mechanisms
span.term: compensatory readaptation of the disturbed circuit (e.g. sprouting of inhibitory terminals) gradually damps the seizure rate after several weeks
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: tetanus toxin light chain cleaves synaptobrevin, so GABA release is permanently gone from the transduced cells while the cells themselves survive
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: and the resulting loss of perisomatic feedforward inhibition lowers the seizure threshold enough that a subconvulsive dose precipitates convulsions and then lasting epilepsy
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: these cells are described as crucial during excitatory challenge and transiently dispensable under basal conditions, which is why a short silencing does nothing on its own
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: with the later decline in seizure frequency attributed to unknown readaptation - inhibitory sprouting, reduced cannabinoid signaling, or compensation by untransduced cells
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Vector expression was not confined to the subiculum, so silenced PV neurons elsewhere in the hippocampus may have contributed.
span.note: what this limits: the attribution of the effect to subicular PV neurons: WE CANNOT EXCLUDE A CONTRIBUTION OF PV NEURONS SILENCED TO SOME EXTENT ALSO IN OTHER HIPPOCAMPAL SUBFIELDS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The absence of any change in overall evoked or miniature postsynaptic currents after silencing is unexplained.
span.note: what this limits: the absence of change in evoked or miniature postsynaptic currents after silencing: THERE IS NO CLEAR EXPLANATION FOR THIS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Why seizure frequency declines after about five weeks is not known.
span.note: what this limits: the decline in seizure frequency after about five weeks: THE UNDERLYING MECHANISMS ARE UNCLEAR
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The seizure frequency the model produces is modest in absolute terms - roughly one to two per week - but still ABOVE the range most patients with temporal lobe epilepsy experience.
span.note: what this limits: the model's relevance to patients: THE FREQUENCY OF SRSs IS MODEST (APPROXIMATELY ONE TO TWO PER WEEK) BUT STILL BEYOND THE RANGE OF SEIZURE FREQUENCY IN MOST TLE PATIENTS · note: claim corrected 2026-08-20 by terminal-a. The previous text read 'The seizure frequency obtained is low relative to most patients with temporal lobe epilepsy.', which REVERSES its own quote: the paper says the rate is modest 'BUT STILL BEYOND the range of seizure frequency in most TLE patients'. limitations[6], grounded on the same sentence, already read it correctly, and the disagreement between the two is what exposed it. The quote, the anchor and the scope are unchanged.
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the vector reached about 61% of parvalbumin cells and spilled beyond the subiculum, so a contribution from other subfields cannot be excluded
span.note: what this limits: the anatomical specificity of the manipulation: THE INJECTIONS WERE NOT EXCLUSIVELY RESTRICTED TO THE SUBICULUM, BUT OFTEN ALSO AFFECTED SOME PV-CONTAINING INTERNEURONS IN SECTOR CA1 AND THE PRESUBICULUM AND PARASUBICULUM
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the standard synaptic measures showed nothing, and the paper says there is no clear explanation for that
span.note: what this limits: the mechanistic account of the behavioural effect: DESPITE THE SIGNIFICANT EFFECTS OF VECTOR INJECTIONS ON THE BEHAVIOR OF THE ANIMALS, NEITHER OVERALL eIPSCs OR EVOKED EPSCs NOR mIPSCs OR mEPSCs WERE AFFECTED IN SUBICULAR PYRAMIDAL CELLS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the seizure frequency the model produces is above what most patients with this epilepsy experience
span.note: duplicate of: limitations[3] · what this limits: the same scope as item 3 - the seizure rate is above the clinical range
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the frequency of SRSs appeared to decline after several weeks, the underlying mechanisms are unclear, and one may consider a variety of mechanisms responsible for this
span.note: what this limits: the time course of the effect: THE FREQUENCY OF SRSs APPEARED TO DECLINE AFTER SEVERAL WEEKS. THE UNDERLYING MECHANISMS ARE UNCLEAR
